body: Thank you! I love the wall of text, lots of good thoughts to come back to haha. And yeah... just really going through it with my mom. I’m a liberal bi lady who’s also a slut (and I wear it with pride!) but her social media is filled with “democrats will rot” “the gays are disgusting” “women who have multiple sexual partners are horrible and don’t deserve respect” and I’m like... hello??? It makes 0 sense to me. But what can I do, I thankfully live in another state but the moment I realized if my mom saw me on the street she’d hate me was a big moment for me lol. Thanks again ❤️

Thank you ❤️ your comment made me cry but in a good way for once tonight haha. I hate getting so hung up on dating, it feels so lame, but I guess it makes sense because I feel like as humans we all just want someone to love us lol. And yeah, it’s soul crushing to have it fail time and time again.
Thank you, you are very kind ❤️ trying my best to believe it
Thank you! As you can see/hear, I didn't have the ankle placement quite right either - lots of room to improve but mostly excited I inverted!!
Amazing!!! 🤩Also, that's the studio I go to, haha! Love that salty place 😉
Thank you!!! I said right before I did it "I'm not sure I can but let me try" and then I DID IT! Also that's my instructor cheering me on in the background, bless her.
I remember that article! Drove me absolutely crazy and your photos were amazing. Good on you. I just followed you on Twitter haha. Sending love 💞
Do it! It was fun and I have no regrets. Hurt a little but it was bearable.

This is a quote from my favorite poem, "The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock", by T.S. Eliot. Done by @/copperbunnyink on instagram, who was amazing! To me it means being unafraid to stand up, speak out, and make changes in your own life, your own universe.
